title: City of San Diego Completes $55 Million in Improvements at Mira Mesa Community Park
description: SAN DIEGO – The City of San Diego has completed a $55 million improvement project at Mira Mesa Community Park, delivering a new aquatic complex, all-wheel plaza, renovated recreation center and other amenities for the community. Council President Pro Tem Kent Lee and Mayor Todd Gloria joined City staff and community members to celebrate the completion of the second phase of construction, which redeveloped the 17-acre space south of New Salem Street.
